settings.name: Cyber Loong Championship
settings.about: An international amateur CS2 tournament in Chongqing, China. Group stage (BO1) plus single-elimination playoffs: quarterfinals BO3, semifinals BO3 (first to 2 wins), BO5 grand final on the big stage.
settings.venue: Three Gorges Harbor Esports Stadium, Zhongxian, Chongqing
settings.arena:
Three Gorges Harbor Esports Stadium (三峡港湾电竞馆) in Zhongxian county, Chongqing — one of China's first professional esports arenas. Built in just 7 months, opened December 2017 with the CMEG Grand Finals.

• 114,000 m² total floor area, 6,096 seats on three tiers
• Octagonal LED cube above the stage + 360° ring screen around the stands
• 16 soundproof match booths for players and casters
• 1000 Mbit dedicated fiber + 1000 Mbit backup line for global broadcast
• Hosted CMEG Grand Finals, CMEL Finals and international festivals

settings.rules:
FORMAT
• Group stage: round robin, BO1, MR12. Winners and runners-up advance: A1 vs B2, B1 vs A2, C1 vs D2, D1 vs C2.
• Quarterfinals: BO3. Semifinals: BO3, first to 2 wins. Grand final: BO5. 3rd place match: BO1.
• Map pool: current competitive pool at tournament date. Veto BO1: ban-ban-ban-ban-pick-pick, decider remains. Veto BO3: ban-ban-pick-pick-ban-ban, decider remains. Veto BO5: ban-ban-pick-pick-pick-pick, decider remains.

ROSTER
• 5 starters + up to 2 substitutes, registered before the start. No roster changes mid-tournament.
• Accounts must be VAC-clean. Smurf accounts are forbidden.

CONDUCT & BANS
• Cheats, scripts, bug abuse — instant disqualification.
• Insults, hate speech, match-fixing — disqualification + ban from next season.
• No-show longer than 15 minutes — technical defeat (13:0).
• Max 4 tactical pauses per map + technical pauses for crashes (round replay by referee decision).

SCHEDULE
• Tournament starts 27 October 2026. Group matches must be played within the announced window. Playoff reschedules only by mutual consent + referee approval.
